DECLARE @tableHTML NVARCHAR(MAX) ; DECLARE @EmailRecipients NVARCHAR(MAX) ; SET @EmailRecipients = @EmailRecipients EXEC PR_PDS_VALIDATE_GENESYS_CALL_RESULT_FILES SET @tableHTML = N'

Good Morning,

Please find below daily breakdown of call lists that have been sent to Genesys dialer for member (on member list) and/or provider (on provider list) outreach and call result files received from the dialer after call attempts have been made. CALLLIST_CD column contains a three digit call list identifiers. CALLLISTDATE_IID column is a system generated key used to identify each call list generated for the day.

SENT_TO_DIALER and RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER columns show counts of members and/or providers sent to the dialer and counts of call results received from the dialer, respectively.

RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_CALL_RESULT column shows counts of records on call result files with valid disposition codes, and RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_NO_CALL_RESULT column shows counts of records on call result files with no valid disposition codes. Records with missing or invalid disposition codes are not processed into PDS and will be rejected.


' + N'' + N'' + CAST(( SELECT td = CALLLIST_CD,'' ,td = CALLLISTDATE_IID,'' ,td = SENT_TO_DIALER,'' ,td = RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER,'' ,td = RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_CALL_RESULT,'' ,td = RECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_NO_CALL_RESULT,'' FROM dbo.PDS_GENESYS_RESULT_FILE_RECORD_COUNT ORDER BY CALLLIST_CD FOR XML PATH('tr'), TYPE) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + N'
CALLLIST_CDCALLLISTDATE_IIDSENT_TO_DIALERRECEIVED_FROM_DIALERRECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_CALL_RESULTRECEIVED_FROM_DIALER_WITH_NO_CALL_RESULT
' + N'

Thank you,

Data Exchange Team

' EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail @recipients= @EmailRecipients , @subject = 'Daily PDS Call Result File(s) Import Alert' , @body = @tableHTML , @body_format = 'HTML'
